characters.name: Old Man
characters.description: A very old, cheerful Jewish farmer of about 100, small and slightly bent but lively, deeply wrinkled warm-brown skin, bright twinkling dark eyes, a long flowing snow-white beard, a cream head wrap, an undyed sand-colored wool tunic with an olive-green sash, bare sun-browned forearms, sandals; carries a small iron-tipped wooden hoe and later a round woven willow basket.

characters.name: Hadrian
characters.description: The Roman emperor Hadrian, a tall, broad-shouldered man of about 45, light olive skin, short curly brown hair and a short neat curly brown beard, thoughtful grey eyes, a golden laurel wreath, a white toga with a broad purple border over a purple tunic, a gold clasp; dignified and curious, friendly to children's eyes, never holding a weapon. Rides a tall white horse with a red saddle cloth.

cover.prompt: A broad fig tree heavy with ripe purple figs stands beside a dusty road. Under it the Old Man smiles, holding up a woven basket full of figs, while Hadrian on his tall white horse leans down toward him with a warm, curious smile. Soft golden morning light, rolling hills with olive trees, wide composition with the fig tree framing both figures.

pages.prompt: A long dusty road through golden hills in the early morning. Hadrian rides at the front on his tall white horse, chin high, followed by a long procession of Roman soldiers in red cloaks and bronze helmets marching in tidy rows, plain red cloth banners fluttering, the soldiers carrying no weapons. Dust glows in the low sunlight. Very wide panoramic shot, the emperor small but clear in front.

At the roadside, the Old Man with his long white beard kneels by a small hole he has dug with his hoe, gently lowering a tiny fig sapling into it. In the background on the road, Hadrian pulls up his white horse to a halt, looking over with surprise. Warm morning light, medium-wide shot with the old man and sapling in the foreground.

Hadrian, still on his white horse, leans forward and calls down to the Old Man with a curious look. The Old Man straightens up, wipes his forehead with the back of his hand and smiles a wide, twinkly smile. The little fig sapling stands between them. Bright morning sun, medium shot, low angle from the old man's side.

Close medium shot of Hadrian raising both eyebrows high in astonishment, one hand spread open toward the tiny sapling, as if asking how this could be. The Old Man, leaning on his hoe, listens patiently with a calm smile. Warm light, soft background of olive trees and hills.

Tender close-up: the Old Man kneels and gently strokes the small leaves of the fig sapling with his wrinkled fingers, speaking softly with a peaceful, wise expression. Hadrian is partly visible in the background, listening. Golden light, shallow focus on the old hands and the young leaves.

A warm memory scene shown as a soft, dreamy vignette: a small boy who has the Old Man's same twinkling eyes sits under a big fig tree eating figs, while a grandfather with a white beard picks fruit above him. In the corner of the picture the present-day Old Man smiles at the memory. Faded golden light, gentle soft edges, medium-wide framing.

Hadrian, thoughtful, gives the Old Man a nod from his white horse and rides on down the road, the procession of soldiers following into the distance. The Old Man stands by his sapling, waving goodbye with his hoe. Late-morning light, wide shot from behind the old man.

Years later, the same roadside spot: the sapling has grown into a broad fig tree with big green leaves and many ripe, soft purple figs. Birds perch on its branches, and its shade spreads over the road. The Old Man, looking just the same, gazes up at it with joy, hands clasped. Rich summer light, wide shot with the tree as the hero.

Inside a Roman palace hall with marble columns and purple curtains, the Old Man walks in carrying a round willow basket heaped with purple figs, smiling proudly. Hadrian on his throne sits forward, recognizing him with a delighted look. Courtiers turn their heads in surprise. Warm light from tall windows, medium-wide shot.

Hadrian, smiling warmly, seats the Old Man on a gilded golden chair and pours shining gold coins, without any markings, into his willow basket. The Old Man laughs in surprise, hand on his heart. Courtiers look on approvingly. Glowing golden light, medium shot, joyful and honoring mood.

A gentle closing scene in an ancient village: a little girl in a long blue dress and a little boy in a terracotta tunic kneel at the edge of an orchard, pressing a single seed into the soil, while behind them a family sits in the shade of a big old fig tree eating figs and smiling. Soft golden evening light, wide, warm framing.
